basemap.clipping: segment intersection with geographic viewport; split at exits and antimeridian discontinuities

readability.method: WCAG relative luminance contrast after source-over alpha compositing on theme paper
readability.adaptation: blend map colors toward contrasting theme ink, then black or white if required; preserve other theme roles

chronology.opening_scene: first route.scene_order ID, otherwise first per_scene insertion-order ID
chronology.opening_range: must hold origin index 0..0; move journey visits into the following scene
chronology.opening_content: sourced geographic basemap only at every time; no itinerary lines, halos, growing tips, place markers, place labels, leaders or region annotations
chronology.location_intro_validation: finite, at least canonical metadata start in nonopening scenes, and before actual scene duration; storyboard cue must match when supplied; planned visits must arrive by the last native frame
chronology.first_location_scene: basemap only before location_intro_sec; reveal origin marker and name at the cue
chronology.route_growth: delay by canonical map_segment_delay after location_intro_sec; draw only completed past segments plus partial current-scene segments
chronology.history: retain all previously introduced place markers, labels and completed routes in later scenes
chronology.unintroduced_places: no markers, names or leaders; reveal each new arrival only when its segment is at least 99 percent complete
chronology.legacy_overview: ignored for visibility and route progress; cannot enable an itinerary preview
chronology.scene_ranges: each following start_index must equal the preceding scene end_index; never skip or replay visits

labels.persistence: unique node IDs through all introduced arrivals; no future names or markers
labels.layout: once for all itinerary nodes, routes and region annotations
labels.opening: no place labels or leaders; geographic basemap only
labels.route_overlap_fallback: prefer zero route intersections; if fitting requires overlap, labels paint last with paper halo
labels.failure: raise; widen viewport, shorten supplied labels or split regional views; never shrink or drop labels
